description: The aspects between two people's birth charts (each one's planets to the other's), with exact orbs and strength.

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude in decimal degrees (north positive)

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude in decimal degrees (east positive)

place.description: Birthplace name, echoed back so the user can check the coordinates

time.description: Local clock time, HH:MM (24-hour). If unknown, omit: noon is used, and houses and angles are then unreliable.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. America/New_York. Historical daylight saving is applied from it.
